items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Bernie Privin, come in and sit in with us. Jack Teagarden, Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy, Artie Shaw, Benny, Chris Griffin, Ziggie Elman, Allen Reuss, guitar.

ctx.x: Did he used to bring a lot of people off the stands?

Well no, mostly everybody knew that about Stuff and used to come up there and sit in you know and play. Artie Dollinger was a saxophone player, later on he was on staff. He used to come in and sit and play with us all the time. Bernie Privin, come in and sit in with us. Jack Teagarden, Jimmy Dorsey, Tommy, Artie Shaw, Benny, Chris Griffin, Ziggie Elman, Allen Reuss, guitar. What's the trombone player's name, oh, he used to be with Benny. He used to come in all the time and sit in.
You were talking about the Band Box and the Rhythm Club. Does the Ellington and Henderson bands used to hang out there?

Oh yeah. All bands. I'll tell you what happened at that club. At the time, Fletcher Henderson was working at the Roseland. Duke was at the Cotton Club I think. I just forget where the Dorseys were playing and Paul Whitman and all the white bands, they were all downtown. But, when everybody would finish work, they would all come up to the Band Box. See the Band Box was their earlier name, later on it was named the Rhythm Club, so that was a regular hangout for all musicians, wherever they were working. So, Duke…
